summary: An excerpt from a fiction novel (Book 10, part 166) in which Ria and Leon talk on a walkway in a utopian setting. Leon asks why Ria and her people have been so secretive and oblique, and Ria explains that they had Leon's graduate work profiled, hoped he would bring something different to the company Ate, and deliberately arranged for a 'good fairy' to counterbalance the corrupting influences of the company. Ria admits they could have hired Leon at any time, and the excerpt ends with them heading toward Viktor, where Leon is given a bunny-suit to wear.
one_line: Ria explains to Leon the hidden reasons behind her secrecy, revealing she had profiled him and shielded him inside the company Ate before they walk into Viktor.
key_facts: Leon asks Ria why there is all the secrecy and obliqueness and funny gaps in her talk.
Ria waits while a pack of grad students scampers by overhead, discussing teleomeres.
Ria says there are things that can't be readily said in utopia and that people get in the habit of speaking out of the back of their heads.
Ria says the average employee at a place like Ate is a bottomless well of desires, trying to figure out what others might desire.
As soon as Leon was hired by Ate, Ria's side generated a dossier on him that included his grad work.
Leon's resume emphasized his grades, not his final projects, and he never spoke of the projects at all.
Ria says they feared Leon would be bent, shaped, made over or ruined if left to his own devices at Ate.
Ria describes the 'dreaded Viktor Culture' as a culture Leon was totally unsuited to, where a new hire either runs screaming or fits in.
Ria says they arranged for a good fairy on Leon's right shoulder to counterbalance the devil on his left shoulder.
Ria says they figured Leon would not last long as a button-polisher and would want out.
Ria says they could have hired Leon any time and could have bought Ate, which would have given him to them.
Ria references the business about making Brautigan into a pair of boots, saying it applies all around.
Leon asks whether she wanted him to walk in the wilderness first, and Ria replies that he is now talking in euphemisms.
The excerpt ends with Leon being given a bunny-suit to wear into the heart of Viktor.
